column1: # screen field batch 12: GameScreen, slice 4 - the world/scene references, the two clocks and the
# world (h) is the World the session mode created; buildingSpriteTable/unitSpriteTable (n/o) are the
# two SpriteSheetLoader tables built from the map definition; aiPlanners (q) is the per-computer
# AIPlanner array (one per non-human player, driven by aiElapsedTime/aiUpdateCount); scene (t) is the
# current GameScene, assigned in createGlResources from the game mode (GameScene.a when hosting a
# non-port-open match, b for the lobby, d for the briefing) and in setScene().
# The clocks: gameTimeNanos (bK) accumulates the raw frame delta (bK += getRawDeltaTime() * 1e9) and
# gameTimeMillis (bL) is bK / 1e6, the value handed to getTimedRegion and divided by 100 for the
# The multi-pointer block is one 16-slot ring: pointerDownTimes (bP, long[16] of press stamps),
# pointerX/pointerY (bQ/bR, the per-slot coordinates the drag delta is computed from) and
# pointerIndex (bO, advanced modulo the ring length each frame). pressX/pressY (bS/bT) remember the
# initial press of the current gesture, boxSelectStartX/boxSelectStartY (bV/bW) the corner a
# Left unnamed: the unused constants w (1000000000L), L/M/N (0.5f/0.5f/1.0f) - nothing reads them -
# plus bU, bX, cd/ce/cf, cm/cn/co and the synthetic switch maps cp..cs, which stay for the next pass
# (their reads live in the input-state and player-loop code that has not been walked yet).
